mechanism.name: ATE：非线性倾向分数下的零因果效应与观测混杂

generation_equations.label: Outcome
generation_equations.expression: Y=m(X)+(A-0.5)*tau(X)+epsilon; epsilon~Normal(0,1), independent of X and assignment uniforms

sampling.dependence: iid individuals with 5 mutually independent Uniform(0,1) baseline covariates

assumptions: Consistency and well-defined binary interventions; no interference.
Conditional exchangeability (Y(0),Y(1)) independent of A given X, implemented by independent assignment uniforms and noise.
Positivity: e=1/2 for randomized data; 1/4 <= e(X) <= 199/256 for the Beta-density assignment.
All confounders observed, finite moments, and the specified continuous regression functions identify the pointwise conditional target where applicable.

properties.notes: Only X1 affects assignment and outcome; X2-X5 are inactive. The Beta-density propensity is nonlinear; the outcome is linear with zero treatment effect. d=5, n=128 is not high dimensional. Source equation (27) has tau(x)=0 and X1-driven confounding. It is separate from equation (28)'s randomized logistic product and the AoS combined setting; a changed estimand alone is not counted as a new family. It is also distinct from the prior Nie-Wager Setup A submission.

estimand.name: theta_ATE=E[Y(1)-Y(0)]
estimand.definition: Superpopulation average effect of A=1 versus A=0, integrating over iid Uniform covariates; not a sample average or observed treated-control mean difference.

truth.expression: Superpopulation average effect of A=1 versus A=0, integrating over iid Uniform covariates; not a sample average or observed treated-control mean difference.
truth.derivation: Analytic ATE: tau(x)=0 everywhere. Independent verification integrates observed-arm IPW moments with Gauss-Legendre and normal Gauss-Hermite; naive population group difference is -1/3.

adaptations: Preserve the source mechanism with dimension=5, noise variance=1; rename source W as A.
Target the superpopulation ATE E[Y(1)-Y(0)]=0 instead of assessing the source CATE estimator. The zero ATE follows from the source tau(x)=0.
Use Python/NumPy PCG64, row-major X, independent uniform-threshold assignment and normal noise; distributional reconstruction, not identical R random samples.
Use n=128, seed=1729 for a CPU interface check instead of the source estimator study (source n=500). No estimator is fitted.
effect_shift=0 is the source mechanism; +/-1 only test nonzero truth sensitivity internally and are not registered source scenarios.

The source fixes marginal Gaussian potential-outcome laws but does not require a cross-world coupling. A single independent noise produces the observed law; a shared-error potential-outcome representation is only a mathematical completion, not an asserted original coupling.
